title: Bad Bunny Earns 2026 MTV VMA Nomination for "NUEVAYoL" in Best Latin
detail: MTV announced the full nominee list for the 2026 Video Music Awards on August 18, 2026. Bad Bunny is nominated in the Best Latin category for "NUEVAYoL," the DTMF opening track, competing against Anitta with Shakira ("Choka Choka"), Fuerza Regida ("TU SANCHO"), Karol G ("Papasito"), Rosalía ft. Yahritza Y Su Esencia ("La Perla"), Ryan Castro, Kapo & GANGSTA ("LA VILLA"), and Shakira & Burna Boy ("Dai Dai"). Fan voting runs through vote.mtv.com until September 25; the ceremony airs live on CBS on Sunday, September 27, 2026.
